versions.content: If a DemComponent is set to available via Dem_SetComponen- tAvailable , all assigned events are also set to `available', including the events of all child nodes (if those nodes are not still set to `not available'). The behavior for the indi- vidual events will be analogous to setting them individually to `available' (e.g. triggering InitMonitorForEvent).
